annotations.title: Send a request to the hotel

description: Sends a non-binding offer request to the reservation team, like the form on the website; also for company stays (company in name, number of employees in employees). Books and charges nothing. Call it only after the guest saw the exact content and agreed to send it (confirm: true) and to the privacy policy (privacy_consent: true); otherwise CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED and nothing is sent. NOT_DELIVERED means nothing was sent: give the hotel phone and e-mail instead. The team answers by e-mail.

confirm.description: true only if the guest explicitly confirmed sending this request.

employees.description: Only for a company stay: the number of employees who would stay.

house.description: Requested house, or all if the guest has no preference.

language.description: Language of texts and links: de, nl, en. Default de.

message.description: The request in the words of the guest.

privacy_consent.description: true only if the guest agreed to the privacy policy (its URL is the link in the CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED answer).

name: request_offer

code.description: Error code when ok is false, e.g. VALIDATION, NOT_FOUND, UNAVAILABLE.

message.description: Readable error message when ok is false.

ok.description: true on success; false with code and message on an error.
